subject: Take-home orchestration & reviewer cadence (inference prompt)
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ally Chen <ally.chen@gmail.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Apr 2027 09:12:02 -0700
Subject: Redwood take-home: inference prompt + deadline

Hi Ally —

Thanks again for interviewing with Redwood. Attached is the take-home prompt for the Inference Engineer role (RI-takehome-inference-prompt.pdf). A few important details below: 

- Deadline: submit by Fri Apr 23, 2027 23:59 PT. If you need a short extension, tell me as soon as possible (we can often add 48 hours).
- Delivery format: a short write-up (1–2 pages) and a runnable code artifact (zip or private GitHub repo link). If you prefer GitHub, please make the repo private and add monica.patel@redwoodinference.com and priyom.das@redwoodinference.com as collaborators or share a private link.
- Review process: Laura and Marcus will do the first pass review; Maya will be the tiebreaker for scoring/fit. We plan to block review time Mon Apr 26 and Tue Apr 27.

Next steps: please reply to confirm you received the prompt and whether the deadline works. Feel free to ask any clarifying questions about the prompt — small clarifications are fine via email.

Best,
Monica Patel
Technical Recruiting | Redwood Inference
Attachment: RI-takehome-inference-prompt.pdf

Hi Monica —

Thanks, I got the prompt and the PDF attached. The deadline works for me. Quick question: is it okay if I submit a private GitHub repo, or do you prefer a zip upload? I can do either. Also, is there a preferred language/runtime (I was planning Python 3.10 + PyTorch) or is that flexible?

Thanks,
Ally

Date: Fri, 16 Apr 2027 10:05:54 -07:00
Subject: Reviewer coordination: Ally Chen take-home (blocks + rubric)

Team —

Thanks for being available to review Ally's submission. A few ops notes so we can be efficient: 

- Review window: please reserve 60–90 minutes on Mon Apr 26 (am/early pm) or Tue Apr 27. I created a provisional calendar block here: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abcd1234-review-slot (accept if the time works).
- Sharing: Monica will collect the submission; please upload code + write-up to the Drive folder linked here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1abcPromptFolder.
- Rubric: attached is a short rubric I drafted in the prompt doc (page 3). Quick summary: correctness (40%), clarity & reproducibility (25%), system design choices & tradeoffs (20%), engineering polish (15%). If you want to tweak weights, reply-all with suggestions by EOD Fri.
- Logistics: Laura/Marcus first pass, Maya tie-break / design scoring if needed. If anyone can't make a full review window, mark which parts you can cover (e.g., code only, write-up only).

Please reply with availability and any rubric changes. If nothing from you by EOD, I'll assume the default slots.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Hiring Manager, Inference Platform | Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Redwood take-home: inference prompt + deadline

Hi Ally —

Thanks for confirming. Private GitHub repo is fine — please add monica.patel@redwoodinference.com and priyom.das@redwoodinference.com as collaborators or send a private invite link. Python 3.10 and PyTorch are perfect. A couple small submission notes:

- Include a README with quick run instructions and any dependency pins (we try to run on a CPU first; if you provide GPU-only steps, include CPU fallback or clear instructions).
- Name your entrypoint script run_inference.py and put test inputs in /sample_inputs.
- After you submit, we'll share a short calendar invite for the review block and drop the code into the review Drive folder.

If you need an extension, say so by Mon Apr 19 EOD. Otherwise, all set and good luck — looking forward to your submission.

Best,
Monica Patel
Technical Recruiting | Redwood Inference
